env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^nested try callbacks ok$'
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go run .
stdout '^nested try callbacks ok$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/nestedtry

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

var (
	inner = errors.New("inner failure")
	outer = errors.New("outer failure")
)

type counts struct {
	calls int
	steps int
}

func step(c *counts) error {
	c.steps++
	return inner
}

func invoke(c *counts, callback func() error) error {
	c.calls++
	return callback()
}

func forwarded(c *counts) error {
	invoke(c, func() error {
		step(c)?
		panic("forwarded callback continued")
	})?
	return outer
}

func consume(c *counts, callback func() (int, error), failure error) (int, error) {
	c.calls++
	_, err := callback()
	if !errors.Is(err, inner) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("callback returned %v, want inner failure", err))
	}
	return 7, failure
}

func assigned(c *counts, failure error) (int, error) {
	value := consume(c, func() (int, error) {
		step(c)?
		return 99, nil
	}, failure)?
	return value, nil
}

func assignedTarget() error {
	type slot struct {
		value int
	}
	var dst slot
	var c counts
	order := ""
	target := func(callback func() error) *slot {
		order += "T"
		if err := callback(); !errors.Is(err, inner) {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("target callback returned %v", err))
		}
		return &dst
	}
	value := func() (int, error) {
		order += "R"
		return len(order), nil
	}
	target(func() error {
		order += "C"
		step(&c)?
		panic("target callback continued")
	}).value = value()?
	if order != "TCR" || dst.value != 3 || c.steps != 1 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("assignment: order=%q, value=%d, steps=%d", order, dst.value, c.steps))
	}
	for i := 0; i < 1; target(func() error {
		order += "C"
		step(&c)?
		panic("post target callback continued")
	}).value = value()? {
		i++
	}
	if order != "TCRTCR" || dst.value != 6 || c.steps != 2 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("loop post: order=%q, value=%d, steps=%d", order, dst.value, c.steps))
	}
	return nil
}

func returned(c *counts) error {
	return invoke(c, func() error {
		step(c)?
		panic("returned callback continued")
	})
}

func deferred(c *counts) error {
	defer invoke(c, func() error {
		step(c)?
		panic("deferred callback continued")
	})?
	return nil
}

func errDeferred(c *counts) error {
	errdefer invoke(c, func() error {
		step(c)?
		panic("error cleanup callback continued")
	})?
	return outer
}

func main() {
	if err := assignedTarget(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	once := counts{calls: 1, steps: 1}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		run func(*counts) error
		includesOuter bool
	}{
		{"forwarded", forwarded, false},
		{"returned", returned, false},
		{"deferred", deferred, false},
		{"errdefer", errDeferred, true},
	} {
		var c counts
		err := test.run(&c)
		if !errors.Is(err, inner) || errors.Is(err, outer) != test.includesOuter || c != once {
			panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: error=%v, counts=%+v", test.name, err, c))
		}
	}
	var succeeded counts
	value, err := assigned(&succeeded, nil)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if value != 7 || succeeded != once {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("assignment success: value=%d, counts=%+v", value, succeeded))
	}
	var failed counts
	if _, err := assigned(&failed, outer); !errors.Is(err, outer) || errors.Is(err, inner) || failed != once {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("assignment failure: error=%v, counts=%+v", err, failed))
	}
	fmt.Println("nested try callbacks ok")
}
